sources.model_ids: Sony SonyModelID values (maker-note tag 0xB001) and Model strings as the cameras write them; each pair cross-checked against independent tools (numbers only)
sources.sensors: Sony specification pages (sensor size in mm; the width in pixels of the largest 3:2 still image, full frame): read 2026-10-13 from web-search excerpts of the pages named; the pages were not fetched (Sony hosts are not reachable from the build environment); verify against the page before relying on the value. Used for the pixel pitch of docs/algorithms/03 section 2.2; sensor_source_kind is 'maker' when the excerpt came from a Sony page and 'restated' when a retailer or reference site restated the Sony specification.

white_scale_source.note: Fitted so the five Kelvin presets of the body's own files (2500, 3200, 4500, 6000, 8500 K) read at their labels on the A7R IV locus (least squares in log chroma). The scale the body's published colour matrix at D65 gives (matrix_scale) leaves a mean preset angle of 2.07 degrees and reads the Daylight preset at 4720 K, outside the limits of docs/03 (at most 2 degrees, Daylight 5000 to 5600 K), so the presets set the scale.
